_comment: How a party's XP budget is split among its members. member_xp = party_xp * share / total_shares. min_band gates exotic templates to rarer encounters. Named party_composition rather than party_archetypes because _ready() auto-loads every *_archetypes.json in this directory as an archetype file.
_comment_disposition: disposition decides whether meeting this party opens combat or opens a conversation. hostile attacks on sight; wary and neutral route through an event where fighting is one choice among talking, trading and leaving. Stateless and per-encounter — no factions, no reputation, nothing remembered. An encounter can override its party archetype's value.
